description: ExitPlanMode gates scoped to unknowns and worktree isolation only. Whether a plan was reviewed is NOT decided here: that is owned solely by plan-oversight/soft_exit.py, which keys on plan content hash and gates on whether Material findings were dispositioned (hard enforcement via PLAN_OVERSIGHT_STRICT_DISPOSITION=1). Two duplicates of that question were removed 2026-07-26 - the exit-plan-mode-gate.sh PreToolUse hook, and plan-unknowns-gate.py's former Stage 1 review-sentinel check, which additionally short-circuited the unknowns audit whenever it hard-denied. The `.review-ready-<slug>` sentinel they depended on is retired; nothing writes or reads it, so exit-plan-mode-cleanup.sh (which renamed it) is gone too. CLAUDE_PLAN_REQUIRE_REVIEW is now inert. PreToolUse: plan-unknowns-gate.py runs a 2-stage state machine, each stage failing open: (1) a Codex (OpenAI CLI, read-only sandbox) unknowns audit that blocks until an '## Open Unknowns' section exists and tags bullets needing active go-find-out research with [investigate]; (2) a closed-loop investigation gate - when agentic unknowns are tagged, it blocks until /investigate-plan has run (proven by a host `.investigated-<slug>` sentinel) or the user waives via /waive-investigation, and fails open when the hermes container is down. plan-worktree-gate.py assesses git-isolation strategy. Both hooks allow 900s; the Codex call inside caps at 840s. PostToolUse: plan-review-cleanup.py clears the investigation and worktree sentinels after a successful exit; exit-plan-mode-schedule-nudge.sh emits an advisory nudge to invoke /schedule-plan-tasks. Degrades to a self-audit instruction when the codex CLI is unavailable; opt out with CLAUDE_PLAN_UNKNOWNS_GATE=0.

hooks.statusMessage: Codex auditing plan for unresolved unknowns...
